short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1207 recent saved-signal files and 323 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @directordaddyy: Just discovered this crazy stylized black and white indie spy neo noir sci fi... and @IntCyberDigest: 🖥️🔥 Two inmates at an Ohio prison built a secret hacking operation from..., plus 7 more. A source image from i0.wp.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became A focused source field grown from Dither Boy - Studio AAA Advanced Image Dithering App.: Full-bleed source-led plate for 2026-09-01. Use product-photo rupture with side-lit object slab; make one giant torn-open black-and-white dither slab crossing the plate at impossible scale, treated like a physical object rather than a poster wall; source windows embedded as threshold failures: small rectangular bite... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against blue slit in upper left-center field, cat-head black silhouette and white eye apertures, and bright square light in upper right.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
